blocks.text: Surrey houses: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

Over the 13 months from September 2025 to September 2026, listings of houses in Surrey peaked at 1,188 in September 2025 and bottomed at 808 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in May 2026 with 97. The reported sale price moved from $1,375,000 to $1,215,000, a change of −11.6%.

faq.q: How many communities does Surrey have?
faq.a: Seven, including City Centre: City Centre, Cloverdale, Fleetwood, Guildford, Newton, South Surrey and Whalley, per the City's own Our Communities page. The board sub-area covering City Centre product is Whalley — "Surrey City Centre" is not a board sub-area name (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: How did Surrey sell in September 2026?
faq.a: In the Surrey board community: 1,120 detached listings with 84 sold at a $1,215,000 median and 28 days on market, and 1,523 Condos & Townhomes listings with 114 sold at a $512,944 median and 25 days — both medians the lowest of the September 2025 – September 2026 period. The highest published sub-area ratios were West Newton detached at 20% and Bridgeview attached at 25% (1 sale on 4 listings, small-count) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Can a Surrey house add a suite or a coach house?
faq.a: One secondary suite per dwelling unit, with habitable floor area at most 40% of the principal dwelling unit and never inside a coach house or garden suite — there is no current 90 m² suite cap in Bylaw No. 12000. A coach house or garden suite runs 35–75 m² (up to 120 m² on RA, R2, R2-O and R3 lots below maximum FAR), and SSMUH allows 3–4 units on most lots by size band, up to 6 near a frequent bus stop.

faq.q: Which SkyTrain serves Surrey now, and what is coming?
faq.a: City Centre is serviced by four SkyTrain stations today, per the City; TransLink states the Surrey-Langley extension will run 16 km along Fraser Highway from King George Station to 203 Street in Langley City, with an anticipated in-service date of 2029.

faq.q: When are property taxes due in Surrey?
faq.a: City of Surrey property taxes are due July 2, with a 5% penalty if not paid by midnight July 2 and a further 5% penalty after September 2.
